 --> Bihar SLET 2026 dummy admit card released; candidates can make corrections until November 5
 BSEB has released the Bihar SLET 2026 dummy admit card, allowing candidates to verify personal details and submit corrections before the November 5 deadline. 
 Sheetal Kumari

 The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has issued the dummy admit card for the Bihar School Librarian Eligibility Test (SLET) 2026, allowing registered candidates to verify their details before the examination. Applicants can access the provisional document through the official registration portal, sletregistration.cbrt.co.in, using their user ID and password. The correction facility will remain available until November 5, 2026.
 Candidates are advised to download their dummy admit cards and carefully check all the information printed on them. Any errors or discrepancies must be reported and corrected through the portal within the stipulated period. The board will not accept changes after the correction window closes.
 The dummy admit card gives applicants an opportunity to identify mistakes in their personal and registration details before the final examination document is issued. Candidates should therefore complete the verification process without waiting until the last day.
 Bihar SLET 2026 dummy admit card: How to download
 Registered applicants can follow these steps to access their Bihar SLET 2026 dummy admit card:
 Visit the official website, sletregistration.cbrt.co.in.
 Log in using the registered user ID and password.
 Find and open the link for the Bihar SLET dummy admit card.
 The provisional admit card will appear on the screen.
 Download the document and check all the information printed on it.
 If any details are incorrect, make the necessary changes through the correction facility and submit them before the deadline.
 Candidates should ensure that the corrections are submitted successfully before November 5. Once the window closes, the board will not accept further modifications.

 Bihar SLET dummy admit card 2026: Details candidates must verify
 After downloading the provisional document, applicants should check their personal information and identification details carefully. The following particulars should be verified:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Registration number
 Father's or mother's name
 Photograph
 Signature
 If any information is incorrect or the photograph and signature do not appear properly, candidates should use the available correction facility within the permitted period.
 Bihar SLET 2026 exam pattern
 The Bihar School Librarian Eligibility Test will be conducted in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. The examination will comprise 150 multiple-choice questions (MCQs).
 Candidates should keep checking the official registration portal for further examination-related announcements and updates. They should also retain a copy of the downloaded dummy admit card and verify that all permitted corrections have been submitted before the November 5 deadline.
